cohort: 100 inpatients of the Anesthesia department in a tertiary care hospital in Tamil Nadu, India undergoing various surgical procedures (25% of which were hernioplasties)
finding: Fentanyl was the most commonly used intraoperative analgesic (75%), but a combination of bupivacaine and fentanyl (37%) provided superior analgesia with less need for additional analgesics.
followup_time: Duration of the surgical procedure (not explicitly stated)
